description: One invoice with doc_no and doc_label (I-12), its lines, what has been paid, the balance, the due date, and whether a bank payment is still clearing. payments lists each card or bank payment: id is the charge_id invoices.refund takes, plus amount, method, status, paid_at, refunded amount and refunds. refunded_minor is money sent back. net_collected_minor is what remains of the payment after that. A payment status is refunded or partially_refunded once the processor confirms. collected_minor stays the amount that was paid, and balance_minor stays what is still owed, which is 0 after a refund. display_status is payment_pending while a bank payment clears (3 to 5 business days), otherwise the invoice status. last_bank_payment_failed_at is set when the latest bank payment failed and the customer can pay again.

next_actions.description: Up to 3 useful next steps, best first, in plain words. op names the op to call, when there is one. when is now, later, check, or tell_human. due_at is set for later and check when there is a natural time. A send is tell_human: show the owner the draft, then send only when they say so.
